cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James grants equity awards as a retention tool, in connection with initial employment or under retention programs for individuals contributing to management, growth and profitability.
items.quote: As an additional retention tool, we may grant equity awards in connection with initial employment or under various retention programs for individuals who are responsible for contributing to our management, growth, and/or profitability.

items.text: Raymond James offers non-qualified deferred compensation plans that serve as a retention tool for the firm.
items.quote: For certain associates who meet compensation, production, or other criteria, we also offer various non-qualified deferred compensation plans that provide a return to the participant, as well as a retention tool to the firm.

items.text: Raymond James offers loans to financial advisors for recruiting and retention purposes, generally repaid over a five-to-ten year period and contingent upon continued affiliation with the firm.
items.quote: We offer loans to financial advisors for recruiting and retention purposes. ... Loans offered are generally repaid over a five -to- ten year period, with interest recognized as earned, and are contingent upon continued affiliation with us.

items.text: Raymond James seeks to mitigate advisor-attrition risk through financial advisor succession planning and by providing financial advisors a broad range of services and resources to support their practices.
items.quote: We seek to mitigate these risks through financial advisor succession planning and by providing our financial advisors with a broad range of services and resources to support their practices.

items.text: Raymond James retains and develops advisors through its Wealth Management Associate Program, Advisor Mastery Program, a department providing growth-oriented tools including business coaching, and conferences and workshops.
items.quote: Individuals who want to become financial advisors can gain relevant branch experience through our Wealth Management Associate Program or move to our Advisor Mastery Program and begin building their client base. We have a department dedicated to providing growth-oriented tools and resources, including business coaching, to our financial advisors. We also offer these advisors the opportunity to participate in conferences and workshops.

items.text: Raymond James grants RSU awards under retention programs, generally restricted for a three-to-five year period and forfeitable on termination other than death, disability or qualifying retirement.
items.quote: We may grant RSU awards under the Plan in connection with initial employment or under various retention programs for individuals who are responsible for contributing to our management, growth, and/or profitability. ... RSU awards are generally restricted for a three - to five-year period. RSUs are generally forfeitable in the event of termination other than for death, disability, or qualifying retirement.

items.text: The firm's 'PCG recruiting and retention-related compensation' includes cash and equity awards issued as retention for existing advisors (and for recruiting and acquisitions), expensed over the requisite service period, typically 5 to 10 years.
items.quote: PCG recruiting and retention-related compensation includes expenses related to cash and equity awards issued in conjunction with recruiting activities, as retention for existing advisors, or in conjunction with our acquisitions ... Such awards are expensed over the requisite service period (typically between 5 and 10 years).
items.definition: PCG recruiting and retention-related compensation includes expenses related to cash and equity awards issued in conjunction with recruiting activities, as retention for existing advisors, or in conjunction with our acquisitions
